messages:
soph (DevEx): Report from a user running through the quickstart with a promo trial code. They completed signup, saw trial credits in Console, but first API call returned 402 with {\"error\":\"card_required_for_trial\"}. They expected the trial to work without adding a card.

harry (Support): Interesting. We do have two trial modes: fully self-serve trial (no card) and promo-trial which still requires a saved card to prevent abuse. Promo codes created for partners currently map to the latter. Did the Console show any banner under Billing?

soph (DevEx): Console shows credits + a small note: \"Promo trial requires payment method on file. Add card to enable usage.\" But the quickstart README and onboarding emails say \"Start using credits immediately\" so the user assumed no card needed.

lucy (Accounts): We intentionally require card for partner promo codes (fraud prevention). The mismatch is that marketing copy and quickstart messaging don't reflect that nuance. We should make that explicit.

devin (SDK): From the SDK side we pass through the 402 and the message. However the Node quickstart sample catches non-2xx and prints \"Auth error: invalid_api_key\" for any 4xx which is misleading here. That made the user think their key was wrong.

harry (Support): Oof. So two problems: (1) docs say no card required, (2) quickstart maps the promo 402 to an auth error.

soph (DevEx): Can we add a small detection in the quickstart: if API returns 402 and error contains \"card_required_for_trial\" then print a helpful message explaining the promo-code semantics and a link to Console -> Billing? Example: 
```
Billing blocked: this promo requires a payment method. Open Console -> Billing and add a card to enable your trial credits.
```

devin (SDK): Yep. I'll change the sample to surface the API error body instead of a generic label and add a specific mapping for card_required_for_trial -> friendly text + link. Opening PR #5102.

lucy (Accounts): I'll update the partner promo email template to state explicitly that some promos require payment method. Also will add a new field on the promo object (ui_hint) so the Console can show clearer copy. Filing internal ticket ACCT-742.

billing-bot: Billing webhook: workspace w-cedar-7 -> payment_method_missing (promo).

harry (Support): Short-term canned support reply: \"If you used a partner promo code and see HTTP 402 / card_required_for_trial, add a payment method at Console -> Billing. Your trial credits will be unlocked immediately. Contact partner rep if you have concerns.\"

soph (DevEx): Also let's change the quickstart README paragraph to: \"If you used a promo code, check the Console billing note — some promo codes still require a card on file. If your first call errors with 402, follow the billing instructions or contact support.\" I'll update the README when the SDK PR lands.

devin (SDK): PR merged to staging with improved error mapping and clearer sample output. Added a one-line CLI helper in the quickstart: \`rwd billing show --workspace $RWD_WORKSPACE\` which prints the billing note so users don't have to hunt in the Console.

billing-bot: Billing flag updated: w-cedar-7 -> active after card added.

harry (Support): Reporter confirmed that after adding a card their first call succeeded and they consumed promo credits. Closing the ticket.

soph (DevEx): Summary action items: 1) Update quickstart README + sample output to mention promo-code exceptions; 2) SDK: map card_required_for_trial -> actionable message; 3) Accounts: add ui_hint to promo object and update partner emails. Thanks all. :tada:
